description.value: Silhouette Cellars is a family-owned winery at The District Wine Village in Oliver, BC, producing award-winning sparkling and still wines from estate-grown Naramata Bench grapes. Their flagship méthode traditionnelle sparkling Chardonnay spent 36 months on lees, earning a devoted following among Okanagan wine enthusiasts. Walk-ins are welcome at the tasting room, making it a natural stop for cyclists touring BC's premier wine country.
